title: File:USS Coronado (AGF-11) bombed by B-52 in 2012.jpg
art: U.S. Air Force photo by Senior Airman Carlin Leslie.
desc: Munitions from a U.S. Air Force Boeing B-52H Stratofortress bomber from the 69th Expeditionary Bomber Squadron strike the decommissioned command ship USS Coronado (AGF-11) during a live-fire event that sunk the ship on 12 September 2012. The sinking was part of exercise "Valiant Shield 2012".
